summary: Chemical detergent handling presents spill, contact, and ingestion risks if left unsecured.

hazards.title: Open Detergent Container
hazards.detail: Uncapped liquid detergent bottle can spill, creating chemical contact and slip risks.
fixSteps: Replace cap firmly immediately after dispensing detergent.
Store bottle high up or in a locked child-proof cabinet.

hazards.title: Dispenser Spill Risk
hazards.detail: Overfilling or dripping detergent outside drawer causes floor slip or machine damage.
fixSteps: Measure liquid accurately up to max fill lines only.
Wipe tray rim and surrounding surfaces immediately.
